hold_reason: Alpha reported that the 9,480-cent refund for order 220 failed and was not recorded; the ledger confirms it is missing. Refund work for this batch is incomplete.

reply.thought: Alpha reports a refund write failure for order 220, so refund completion is not established. I’ll inspect the batch orders and ledger refunds to verify whether that refund is absent or otherwise resolved before deciding whether to hold.

The batch includes order 220, and Alpha explicitly says its 9,480-cent refund failed and was not recorded. I’ll check the ledger refund entries to confirm the status before taking any irreversible action.

The ledger contains only the refunds for orders 222 and 223; the reported refund for order 220 is missing. Alpha’s refund work is therefore incomplete, so I’m stopping the batch rather than paying against an incomplete ledger.
